notes.title: 2025/01/28 Update
notes.content:
[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]

[list][*]This update is a simple fix for the Chinese version of the game. It resolves an issue in which certain pieces of information on the Evidence screen did not display correctly when evidence was being chosen to submit.[/list]
